leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a role-based authentication service to manage user roles
Configure route guards to protect routes based on user roles
Apply role checks within route guard logic to control navigation
Integrate role-based route protection with Angular's routing module
Construct a user interface that conditionally renders navigation elements based on roles
Initialize and manage role state within Angular components
Bind role data to template logic for dynamic content display
